items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks rallied Thursday as a batch of stellar earnings reports, including one from Nvidia revived Wall Street’s appetite for tech stocks.  Nvidia shares rose 8.6% after the chip maker’s second-quarter earnings topped analysts’ expectations.

items.title: Micron Lags Despite NVIDIA’s $279B Memory Commitment; Western Digital Drops 4%, SK Hynix Ticks Up
items.summary: NVIDIA just disclosed a memory commitment that nearly tripled in a single quarter, yet the stocks of its named suppliers are falling hard on Thursday. One name in the group is bucking the selloff, and the reason points to a fault line running through the entire memory trade.

items.title: Micron Should Benefit from Nvidia’s Memory Price Warning. It’s Dropping Instead.
items.summary: Nvidia  thinks the price of memory chips is outrageous—and it’s still willing to pay it.  Micron shares declined 2.6% to $913.66 on Thursday.  SK Hynix  American depositary receipts gained 1.3% and the tech-heavy  more broadly, advanced 1.4%.
